        int len = s.length() - 1;
        int atPosition = -1;
        String output = "";
        String temp = "";

        // Find position of "at"
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
            if (i + 1 <= len && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                atPosition = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        // Build the first part
        output += s.charAt(0);
        for (int i = 1; i < atPosition; i++) {
            if (i + 2 <= len && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                output += temp;
                temp = "";
                output += '.';
                i += 2;
            } else {
                temp += s.charAt(i);
            }
        }
        output += temp;

        // Append '@'
        output += '@';

        // Reset temp for second part
        temp = "";

        // Build the second part
        for (int i = atPosition + 2; i <= len; i++) {
            if (i + 2 <= len && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                output += temp;
                temp = "";
                output += '.';
                i += 2;
            } else {
                temp += s.charAt(i);
            }
        }
        output += temp;

        System.out.println(output);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
